title: K Manga Adds Onijoroku's Twisted Devotion Manga
content: K MANGA released Ōnijōroku 's Twisted Devotion manga in English on Monday. K MANGA describes the story: Delinquent Tanaka is feared by all and nicknamed the Mad Dog. He fought every day, and rumors and whispers about him filled the school halls.
author: ANN

title: Manga Up! Global Adds Venus in December, Paranormal Agent Adashino Manga
content: Manga UP! describes Venus in December : When 29-year-old illustrator Kei quits his job to rethink his future, his editor friend gives him a bizarre request: move in with the brilliant but notoriously difficult 32-year-old novelist Hijiri Saionji to keep him on schedule—and draw his portrait while he's at it.
author: ANN

title: Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titans Arc's 3rd Trailer Reveals October 2 Debut
content: The staff for Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titans Arc (T okyo Revengers: Santen Sensō-hen ), the latest arc of the Tokyo Revengers anime, presented its third trailer on Sunday.
author: ANN

title: Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titans Arc (Season 4) Reveals Third Trailer, Anime Expo 2026 Appearance
content: Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titans Arc (Season 4) sequel anime revealed a new trailer, along with an October 2 premiere date. The anime previously revealed the voice cast for the founding members of Black Dragon , as well as South Terano. The anime will stream exclusively on Disney+ worldwide.
author: Anime Corner

title: Kyoto Animation's Sparks of Tomorrow Anime Reveals New Visual and Broadcast Trailer
content: Sparks of Tomorrow anime by Kyoto Animation revealed a new key visual and trailer ahead of its July 5, 2026 premiere. The anime by Kyoto Animation will stream exclusively on Netflix . Minoru Ota is directing the TV anime, with Tatsuhiko Urahata in charge of the script.
author: Anime Corner

title: Love Live! Nijigasaki High School Idol Club Final Chapter Movie Unveils Key Visual
content: Love Live! Nijigasaki High School Idol Club Final Chapter Part 3 movie, set to begin this winter , has unveiled its key visual featuring the never before seen dance costumes of Karin Asaka and Kasumi Nakasu. The announcement was made after Nijigasaki’s 8th live concert, “Love Live!

title: 'Oni no Hanayome' Unveils Additional Staff, Theme Songs, First Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Kureha 's Oni no Hanayome ( The Ogre's Bride ) novel unveiled additional staff, a key visual (pictured), the theme songs, and first promotional video on Sunday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on July 5 at 12:30 a.m.
author: MyAnimeList

title: The Ogre's Bride Anime's New Video Unveils Theme Songs, More Staff, July 4 Debut
content: The staff for the television anime of Kureha 's The Ogre's Bride ( Oni no Hanayome ) light novel series presented the anime's full promotional video and a new key visual on Sunday.

title: Sparks of Tomorrow Anime Reveals New Promo Video, 5 More Cast Members
content: The staff for the television anime of Hiro Yūki 's Sparks of Tomorrow ( 20 Seiki Denki Mokuroku ) novel revealed a pre-broadcast promotional video on Sunday. The staff also revealed a new visual and more cast.
